enrichment.headline: Approves up to $5M for KABOOM! to build up to 20 new playspaces at school sites through 2026
enrichment.summary: The district signs a master agreement with KABOOM!, Inc. to build up to twenty new playspaces at school sites that both sides agree on. Each playspace can cost up to $250,000, and the total across all of them cannot exceed $5,000,000. The agreement runs from February 23, 2023 through February 22, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Pays Anthonio, Inc. up to $23,760 to inspect the Oakland International High School alarm project
enrichment.summary: Anthonio, Inc. will serve as the inspector of record for the intrusion alarm project at Oakland International High School. This is the state-certified project inspection required by the Division of the State Architect (DSA). The limit of $23,760 includes up to $2,160 for additional services, and work runs from February 23, 2023 to December 31, 2023.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adds $49,147.06 to CWS Construction's Castlemont High field and bleachers contract for repairs
enrichment.summary: This change order adds drainage, sewer and concrete repairs to the Castlemont High School field and bleachers replacement project. The work comes from several preliminary change orders (PCOs), including new base rock, plumbing fixes for restroom floor drains, and traffic-rated lids for turf field drain boxes. It raises the contract limit from $8,619,585.71 to $8,668,732.77.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
